title: Pearl's Causal Hierarchy
summary: 关联、干预和反事实是不同层级的因果查询；观察条件概率不能自动替代干预。
statement: Observational association does not in general identify the effect of an intervention.
assumptions: 因果问题需要一个足以表达干预/混杂结构的模型或实验设计
doesNotImply: 一次 leave-one-out ablation 就自动识别了因果关系
engineeringImplications: 把相关性发现与因果根因区分开
设计干净的干预、对照和混杂检查

sources.label: Judea Pearl — The Three-Layer Causal Hierarchy
